brief:
Dr. Mona Dumidi, vice president for artificial intelligence at the Arab American University, has been appointed as Palestine's responsible AI governor to the Global Responsible AI Council, the Ma'an news agency reported. The appointment positions her as the official Palestinian representative on the international body overseeing AI governance matters.

Dumidi's role will involve advancing Palestinian perspectives and interests within global frameworks for responsible artificial intelligence development and policy. The appointment underscores the Palestinian institutional commitment to participating in international discussions shaping how AI technologies are deployed and regulated worldwide.
